row.team_price_text: Live Testing: $39/mo billed annually (1 parallel test, unlimited users)
row.evidence: Sauce Labs' SSO setup docs list 'SCIM (System for Cross-domain Identity Management)' under 'The following SSO-related features are currently not supported'; SSO itself is an Enterprise Level feature on the pricing page.
row.notes: Changed from June gated to none: June said SCIM was available via Okta on Enterprise, but Sauce Labs' own SSO docs now list SCIM as unsupported, Okta's catalogue app shows SAML only, and provisioning is JIT on SAML login (Enterprise). Pricing is per parallel test with unlimited users (Live Testing $39/mo annual or $49 monthly; Virtual Device Cloud $149; Real Device Cloud $199), so per-user fields are null. A REST Accounts API can create, update, deactivate and reactivate users and manage teams.

scim.notes: Sauce Labs' SSO docs list SCIM under 'Unsupported features'.

limitations.text: SCIM and Single Logout are not supported; only one identity provider per Sauce Labs organization.

user_api.notes: Team management and adding/deactivating users are Enterprise features in the UI; the Accounts API page does not state a plan for the user endpoints (only Service Accounts are marked 'Enterprise Plans Only'). EU base: api.eu-central-1.saucelabs.com.

rate_limits.text: Authenticated endpoints: 10 requests per second or 3,500 per hour; unauthenticated: 2 per minute.

okta.notes: OIN page marks only SAML as checked (read from page markup); Sauce Labs' Okta guide lists SSO and JIT only.

entra.notes: Sauce Labs' Entra guide picks the 'Sauce Labs' gallery app for SAML; no Microsoft Learn page checked.

onelogin.notes: From Sauce Labs' OneLogin guide; OneLogin's own page not loaded.

citations.quote: Lookup Users GET /team-management/v1/users/ Queries the organization of the requesting account and returns the number of users matching the query

citations.title: Accounts | Sauce Labs Documentation
citations.quote: Create a New User POST /team-management/v1/users/ Creates a new user in your Sauce Labs organization.

citations.title: Accounts | Sauce Labs Documentation
citations.quote: Update a User PUT /team-management/v1/users/{user_id} Replaces all values of the specified user profile with the new set of parameters passed in the request.

citations.title: Accounts | Sauce Labs Documentation
citations.quote: Partially Update a User PATCH /team-management/v1/users/{user_id} Allows you to update individual user values without replacing the entire profile.

citations.title: Accounts | Sauce Labs Documentation
citations.quote: Deactivate a User POST /team-management/v1/users/{user_id}/deactivate/ Suspends the specified user's account, preventing all access to Sauce Labs while deactivated.

citations.title: Accounts | Sauce Labs Documentation
citations.quote: Activate a User POST /team-management/v1/users/{user_id}/activate/ Re-activates the specified user's account, if it had been previously deactivated.

conflicts.text: Okta's catalogue overview says its SauceLabs integration offers SAML SSO 'along with provisioning capabilities', but the page marks only SAML as checked and Sauce Labs' own docs list SCIM as unsupported (the only provisioning they document is JIT on SAML login). Vendor docs used for behaviour.

open_questions: Which plans can call the Accounts (team-management) API is not stated.
Whether API deactivation frees a seat is not relevant to pricing (unlimited users) but session revocation is undocumented.
